high_total.label: Overs in a high-total game (48+)
high_total.desc: Yardage and catch overs when the Vegas game total is 48 or more.

dog_wr1.label: Underdog's #1 receiver, receiving yards overs
dog_wr1.desc: The underdog team's top projected receiver (a WR): receiving-yard overs.

dog_qb.label: Underdog QB passing yards overs
dog_qb.desc: Passing-yard overs for the underdog's quarterback (trailing teams throw more).

low_rung.label: Lowest rung of the ladder
low_rung.desc: The easiest line on a player's yardage or catch ladder.

cheap_over.label: Cheap overs (10-25¢)
cheap_over.desc: Yardage and catch overs priced 10-25¢; they tended to climb before kickoff, so buy early.

cb1_out.label: WR2 facing a defense missing its top corner
cb1_out.desc: Receiving overs for the WR2 when the opposing top corner is out (offenses shifted ~1.2 pts of target share to him).

dbs_out.label: WR2/WR3 facing 2+ missing defensive backs
dbs_out.desc: Receiving overs for the WR2/WR3 when 2+ opposing corners/safeties are out (WRs +1.4 pts of target share).

lb_out.label: TE1 facing a missing starting linebacker
lb_out.desc: Receiving overs for the TE1 when an opposing starting linebacker is out (TE1s +0.7 pts of target share).

low_total.label: Overs in a low-total game (42.5 or less)
low_total.desc: Yardage and catch overs when the Vegas game total is 42.5 or less hit LESS often than priced.

rb_td.label: Running back anytime TD
rb_td.desc: Anytime-TD YES on running backs scored LESS often than priced, most of all on underdogs.

timing.anytime_td: Buy TDs late (after inactives): TD prices slip ~0.5¢ into kickoff.
timing.win: Moneylines can be taken early in the week.
timing.total: No timing edge found on totals.
timing.props: Buy late (after inactives), when spreads are tightest; cheap overs (10-25¢) are the exception: they climb ~2¢ from 2 days out.
